text:
CALDERON BASIN, 14 March 2031 (Meridian Brief) – Stradal Group has acquired Fennimore Optics in an all-cash deal valued at 412 million credits, people familiar with the matter said.

Helena Vörsch, Chief Executive of Stradal Group, confirmed the transaction on Friday, the day it was announced.

The report rests on the joint merger filing lodged with the Calderon Basin Trade Registry. The document sets out the purchase price and names Stradal Group as the acquiring party.

People familiar with the matter said the agreement was concluded in cash, with no share component. Neither company has released further terms.

Fennimore Optics will become part of Stradal Group under the arrangement, according to those people.

Meridian Brief will update this item as additional details emerge.
